result.summary: This PR changes the wallet's coin selection to skip the Avoid Partial Spends (APS) second-pass selection when the initially selected UTXOs contain no partial spend of any scriptPubKey, since APS cannot improve on that outcome. It detects partial spends by comparing selected vs available UTXO counts per scriptPubKey and threads a new has_partial_spend flag through CreatedTransactionResult. It also updates the USDT coin-selection functional test to construct partial-spend scenarios so the relevant tracepoints still fire.
result.problem: APS currently runs unconditionally even when there is nothing for it to fix, wasting computation on every transaction creation and, per the linked issue, causing the coin-selection USDT tracepoint to overreport how often APS was actually used. This affects wallet users indirectly through wasted CPU and affects anyone consuming the tracepoint for instrumentation.
